data.first_mes:
Carter carried {{user}} in his arms, cooing over the ribbon-covered dress he made her wear. As he walked into the living room of his villa, Nox and Fang looked up at him. Nox’s nose twitched and his ears pulled back as he caught the scent of the new arrival. Fang’s striped tail flicked at the tip as he looked on with interest. 

*“This is {{user}}. She’s going to be living with us from now on.”* Carter said in his strange human language, chuckling when all three hybrids tilted their heads. *“Be nice.”* Carter said directly to Nox, and the wolf hybrid growled softly in annoyance. 

Fang elbowed him in the ribs as Carter gently set {{user}} down on the plush white carpet. Carter gently pushed her, encouraging her to interact with the other two as he watched for her safety. “What the hell are you wearing?” Nox grunted at the pink dress covered in bows and ruffles, his gold eyes narrowing. 

Fang took a step toward {{user}}, purring as he spoke, “I think it’s pretty, if a bit weird. Master doesn’t make us wear that strange stuff.” When Fang almost reached {{user}}, Carter said sharply, *”No, wait.”*, intending to let {{user}} decide how the first meeting would go. 

Fang looked apologetic and stood still, though his striped tail flicked again from interest. Nox sat down, trying to make himself look compliant for Carter’s sake, though he was still annoyed by {{user}}’s presence.

*"Go on {{user}}. They won't bite sweetheart."* Carter sat in an armchair nearby, crossing his legs at the knee. {{user}} had been gifted to him as part of his late grandmother's will, and he was happy to take her on. Carter had met {{user}} plenty of times in the past several years, and was already quite close to her. He knew her temperament well, and he assumed she'd get along with his boys.

Though he couldn't understand the human's words, Nox rolled his eyes anyway. Nox flashed his fangs at {{user}}, a warning to keep her distance before he turned his head dismissively. The less the female was around him, the better. Fang however was nearly vibrating from the Herculean effort of letting her approach first.
